title: Information Gain-Guided Causal Intervention for Autonomous Debiasing Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated in Question Answering (QA) tasks by examining whether models rely on the fame or social prominence of individuals or locations (e.g., well-known vs. less-known entities) to predict answers, rather than comprehending the provided context.

Evaluated in Sentiment Analysis (SA) tasks by testing whether models incorrectly predict negative sentiment solely based on the presence of negation words (e.g., 'not') in a sentence, even when the overall sentiment is positive.

Evaluated in Natural Language Inference (NLI) and Paraphrase Identification (PI) tasks using challenge datasets like HANS and PAWS to determine if models rely on the spurious feature of high word overlap or syntactic similarity between sentences to incorrectly predict entailment or semantic equivalence.
